based_on.basis: User-supplied initial assessment and conditional equivariance-to-closure argument; registry RER-T02, sections 5.1–5.2 and 8.

source_delivery_question: Does the independently specified standalone K3 vector law commute with every simultaneous proper B-isometry on its declared domain, including its incidence, fixed parameters, orientation convention, and event/admissibility rules? Supply the law/jet, clock, domain, and either exact proof or an explicit failure witness. A jet proof must retain the remainder and exact-closure limitations.

symmetry_precheck.group: SO(B)={R in GL(2,R): R^T B R=B, det R=1}; linear proper B-isometries, not affine translations
symmetry_precheck.observable: Phi=(Qs,Qc,Isc,Omega_G) with the unchanged primitive Omega_G convention
assumptions: D is a declared SO(B)-invariant subset of Qs>0 with all actual-source restrictions included.
T is the independently supplied deterministic law, not defined to force quotient closure.
For a reduced endomap on Phi(D), T(D) must lie in D. Otherwise specify an output patch, exit/termination symbol or another continuation contract.
All variable parameters, hidden receiver/history data and additional roles must be part of the source state and action before applying this V^2 theorem.
For partial events, admissibility/trigger/terminal classifications must be constant on readout fibres, or be retained as extra observable state.
symmetry_precheck.sufficient_condition: T(rho_R x)=rho_R T(x) for all R in SO(B) and x in D.
symmetry_precheck.conditional_consequence: Static orbit separation from RER-T02 implies a unique reduced update F on Phi(D) with Phi o T = F o Phi under the declared endomap/domain premises.
symmetry_precheck.proof: If Phi(x)=Phi(xprime), static completeness provides R with xprime=rho_R x. Equivariance and invariance of Phi give Phi(Txprime)=Phi(rho_R Tx)=Phi(Tx). Apply registry section 5.1. Uniqueness is only on Phi(D).
symmetry_precheck.not_necessary: If equivariance fails, test Phi(T(rho_R x))=Phi(Tx) directly. A nonzero vector equivariance defect alone is not a closure counterexample.

optional_exact_symbolic_test.status: method only; not applied to an actual K3 law
optional_exact_symbolic_test.regularity: C1 source map on an open SO(B)-invariant domain, with complete rotation orbits in the domain
optional_exact_symbolic_test.meaning: E_T=0 identically is equivalent to full connected SO(B) equivariance under these hypotheses. Differentiate R(-theta)T(R(theta)x).
optional_exact_symbolic_test.direct_closure_residual: For q(x)=Phi(T(x)), Dq(x) J x=0 identically proves constancy on connected rotation orbits even when E_T != 0.
optional_exact_symbolic_test.flow_guard: A vector-field equivariance check concerns its flow only with local uniqueness and a common existence/domain convention; it is not an identification of the ODE time-one map with a discrete return.

finite_order_guards: Commutation with a sixfold rotation or bare sign alone is not equivariance under all SO(B).
Polynomial/jet equivariance proves only the declared finite-order result unless the supplied law is exactly that polynomial or the full remainder is handled.
Numerical sampling of rotations is a search or witness procedure, not a proof for all rotations.
If T(0)=0, n>=1, and T=J_n T+O(||x||^(n+1)), the homogeneous-quadratic readout transports the tail at order O(||x||^(n+2)); that estimate still does not close the exact reduced map.
For a failure witness, match the same admitted state/domain/clock and prove the successor-readout difference, with remainder control when needed.
symmetry_precheck.physical_scope: SO(B) is the kinematic fibre action of this readout. No physical gauge, pole relabel or RRF profile is selected.

test_sequence.action: Obtain and pin one standalone K3 law, state/incidence, clock, domain and source evidence; keep all missing fields unresolved.
Verify readout fibres and the action/domain/event contract. Include forward invariance or explicit exit/chart handling.
Test full proper-B-isometry equivariance first. Use exact symbolic identities or the C1 generator criterion when applicable.
If exact equivariance succeeds, prove signed-Gram closure. If it fails, inspect successor Phi: distinguish same-observable non-equivariance from a genuine same-readout/different-successor witness.
Only after a witnessed failure, investigate an explicit state/history augmentation; no claim that an added variable is unique, minimal or sufficient until its own closure test.
Proceed to cycle/network closure only with admitted coupled-edge state and update.
